title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's in Geo-information Science and Earth Observation
description: Fully funded two-year master's across European universities. Several GIS and remote sensing programmes in the catalogue. Pakistani applicants are regularly selected.

title: DAAD EPOS development-related postgraduate courses
description: Funded master's in Germany for applicants with two years of work experience. Includes geodesy, photogrammetry and environmental programmes.

title: Chinese Government Scholarship, CSC
description: Master's and PhD in Chinese universities with strong remote sensing groups, including Wuhan, Beijing Normal and CAS institutes. Apply through HEC or directly to the university.

title: Fulbright Master's and PhD Programme for Pakistan
description: The largest Fulbright programme in the world. Geography, environmental science and urban planning are eligible fields.

title: HEC Overseas Scholarships and Indigenous PhD Fellowships
description: Rolling programmes for MS and PhD abroad and in Pakistan. Check the current phase and the list of eligible fields.

title: End-to-End Google Earth Engine
description: The most complete free Earth Engine course, from basics to supervised classification and time series. Self-paced with full materials.

title: NASA ARSET applied remote sensing trainings
description: Free webinar series on floods, agriculture, air quality, and disasters, with certificates of completion.

title: Esri MOOCs
description: Six-week courses with a free temporary ArcGIS licence. Cartography, spatial data science, and imagery courses run several times a year.

title: Geocomputation with R
description: Open textbook for spatial analysis in R. Pairs well with the statistics modules.

title: GISP, Certified GIS Professional
description: Portfolio plus exam based certification recognised by international employers. Worth planning for after a few years of work.

title: Esri Technical Certification
description: Role-based exams for ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Enterprise. Useful for Esri partner employers in the Gulf.

title: GIS Analyst, urban planning consultancy

description: Fresh graduates with QGIS or ArcGIS Pro and basic Python. Islamabad based. Shared by an alumnus.

title: Remote sensing internship, summer 2027
